protocol.checkpoint_selection: Validation composite: .25 replay direct raw accuracy +.50 reasoning direct raw accuracy +.25 free-running scaffolded trace final raw accuracy; direct NLL tie-break.
protocol.outer_guard: Stop/select previous eligible checkpoint if old-validation raw accuracy falls>2percentage points or full-vocabulary NLL rises>.10nats.
recovery_changes: Restart from eligible128 checkpoint with fresh optimizer; do not resume rejected384 weights.
Reduce both learning rates4x; double core gold CE weight; increase old outer KL preservation4x.
Train gain estimator from matched counterfactuals but use threshold1 during training, above its.1 gain bound; outer learning stays on Stay.
Reduce control loss5x and ramp it more slowly; inference threshold still selected on validation after training.
protocol.recovery_interpretation: Adaptive recovery based on validation; this bundle does not isolate which change causes an effect.

selected_policy.tie_break: fewer turns, then larger threshold, then smaller layer/alternative indices

score_permutation_diagnostic.scope: Exploratory CPU recombination of frozen held-out branch metrics; no additional inference or policy selection.
score_permutation_diagnostic.method: Permute controller scores across individual examples; preserve the exact number of turns.
score_permutation_diagnostic.inference_note: The interval describes the permutation null, not a program-bootstrap confidence interval or a preregistered confirmation test.

deployed_vs_cached_diagnostic.interpretation: Deployment-style inference dispatches only the selected MLP per example; diagnostic branches execute homogeneous candidate batches and recombine scalar metrics. Grouped BF16 dispatch is a plausible numerical source, not isolated experimentally. Deployed metrics are primary; oracle/fixed-action/permutation metrics remain separately labelled diagnostics. No policy or weights were revised from this difference.

restoration_check.scope: Fixed full-vocabulary output probe before and after the temporary restoration context.

original_core_restore.interpretation: Positive paired gain means the trained outer model performs better with its newly trained core transformer than with the old core. This measures reliance/coadaptation under the current shell and interfaces, not standalone reasoning or causality attributable to any single loss.

membership_screen.scope: Frozen adapted initial weights, validation only, no updates or architecture selection.
limitations: Diagnostic direct-core readouts only; no trained relocated controller or routing map.
Selected blocks skip pretrained transitions and have received no membership-specific adaptation.
One/two/four passes use different execution budgets; compare memberships within each pass count.
All layouts share fixed INITIAL weights; these validation observations are not held-out test claims.
Logical central membership does not imply contiguous VRAM placement.
Optional traces use predicted digits and fixed scaffolding, not unrestricted text generation.

limits: Single training seed; adaptive validation-guided recovery.
Training changes are a bundle, not a causal ablation of distillation, recurrence, learning rates, or routing.
One delayed MLP substitution per prediction, not repeated unconstrained sphere traversal.
Four tied core passes reuse weights but increase computation; no latency improvement is established here.
Scaffolded traces restrict digit/answer outputs and feed back predicted values; not unrestricted text generation.
Old test was previously inspected; it is a retention check. New test/OOD were first scored after selection.
Zero/restoration ablations measure relevance and coadaptation, not independent reasoning ability.
